name: B10-0228/2025 (PPE) – Execution spree in Iran and the confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the execution spree in Iran and confirmation of the death sentences of activists Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Iran. It condemns the death penalty, which it says Iran uses to silence anyone who disagrees with the government. It calls for an immediate stop to all executions and for the release of two activists, Behrouz Ehsani and Mehdi Hassani, whose death sentences were confirmed. It also asks the European Union to sanction those responsible for human rights abuses and to treat Iran's Revolutionary Guard as a terrorist organisation.

- Nothing changes in law; Parliament only states its opinion and makes requests.
- The requests concern Iran's government, two named prisoners and all political prisoners on death row.
- Next, the text goes to the Council, the Commission and Iran's authorities; no vote or action is described.
